disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully obtaining registration through false statements or fraudulent diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who shall unlawfully obtain registration under this chapter, whether by false or untrue statements contained in the application to the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine or by presenting to the board a fraudulent diploma, certificate for license, or one fraudulently obtained

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing without any registration or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or by practicing without any registration or certificate shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor

the board, after hearing pursuant to the Arkansas Administrative Procedure Act, by a majority vote may also revoke the certificate and cancel or suspend the registration of any person of whom the court records of a court of any state or territory within the United States or of the federal courts or the records of any court of jurisdiction in any foreign country show that the person has been found guilty of a criminal offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registration was granted upon mistake of material fact
